config.connectionsDescription: Pool of LLM connections shared across modules. Bind one to each purpose below.
config.formDescription: Configure an LLM endpoint. The pool is shared across all AI features.
config.localEngineHint: A local engine runs on a private address, which the server refuses until an operator allows it: set LLM_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=true and restart the backend. Keep the host.docker.internal address — from inside the container, localhost is the container itself.
config.noConnectionsHint: Add a connection to start using AI features (Vision, Recipes, …).
config.cannotDeleteBound: This connection is bound to a purpose. Unbind it first.
config.noEligibleConnections: No connections with the {{capability}} capability yet.
config.serverDefaultHint: Served by the server's default model. Pick a connection to use your own instead.
config.noConnectionsServerDefaultHint: Some AI features already run on the server's default model. Add a connection to use your own instead.
config.errorNameTaken: A connection with this name already exists
config.testFailed: Connection test failed. Check credentials and base URL.
config.testNeedsApiKey: Type the API key into the field above first: the test sends what is in this form, not a stored key.
config.testNeedsBaseUrl: Fill in the API base URL above first: this provider is reached over HTTP, so the test needs its address.
config.testContractOk: Connection works — the model answered in the expected shape. {{count}} models available.
config.testReadAll: Connection works — the model read all {{of}} fields on the sample label.
config.testReadPartial: The answer had the right shape, but the model read only {{matched}} of {{of}} fields on the sample label — it may be filling in values it never saw.
config.testContractOk_one: Connection works — the model read the sample label. {{count}} model available.
config.testContractOk_other: Connection works — the model read the sample label. {{count}} models available.
config.testContractFailed: The key works, but the model did not return usable data. It replied: {{preview}}
config.testUnchecked: Credentials work — {{count}} models available. The output was not checked for these capabilities.
config.testUnchecked_one: Credentials work — {{count}} model available. The output was not checked for these capabilities.
config.testUnchecked_other: Credentials work — {{count}} models available. The output was not checked for these capabilities.
config.testShapeNotEnforced: This provider does not enforce the response shape, so the result relies on the parser and one retry. It can still fail later.
config.testReaderOk: The key works — the reader fetched a test page.
config.testReaderFreeTier: No key on this connection — it runs on the reader's free tier, with nothing to test.
config.testReaderEmpty: The key works, but the reader brought nothing back from the test page.

config.fieldCapabilitiesHint: What this model can be asked for. The ticks are a suggestion from the provider — the connection test is what settles it.
config.purposeUnavailableHint: This purpose belongs to {{module}}, which is switched off. A binding made here takes effect once the module is enabled.
config.capabilityUnverified: Declared, not yet checked — run the connection test
config.capabilityFailedHint: The model did not manage what this connection claims. It is not offered for purposes that need it until the test passes.
config.connectionFailedCapability: {{names}} is not on this list: it failed the {{capability}} test.
